paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Arakhin 28b](https://www.sefaria.org/Arakhin.28b.8), speaking before Rabbi Abbahu.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Chizkiyah bar Biloti raise a question before Rabbi Abbahu. Hyman’s heading reads Biluto (בילוטו), beside Biloti (בילוטי) in the linked witness.
